author: Arnav
problem: Read N foods with tastiness A_1..A_N and K food numbers B (from 1) that Takahashi dislikes. He eats one of the foods with the highest tastiness, chosen at random. Print Yes if he might eat a food he dislikes, otherwise No.
bug_description: Stores food positions from 0 (i) instead of from 1 (i+1), so they don't line up with the 1-based disliked numbers.

comments.accurate: Records each tastiness value's food numbers and checks whether any tastiest food is disliked
comments.wrong_behavior: Records each tastiness value's list positions from 0 and checks them against the disliked numbers
comments.wrong_location: Food numbering verified; check max(A) when several foods tie for tastiest
